title: atrostemma manarae
intro: Atrostemma manarae, commonly known as the "Wild Cucumber", is a plant species belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Atrostemma manarae include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a sedative, reduce fever, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Atrostemma manarae include cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
